ItemID: NA; Title: Stadium Arcadium; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its funkier rock sound is less appealing than the heavier music I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Year Zero; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its darker industrial sound interests me, but I would choose guitar-driven metal first today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Iv; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not tell me enough to choose it confidently.
ItemID: NA; Title: City of Evil       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The melodic metal and energetic guitar work fit my interest in In Flames and heavier rock.
ItemID: NA; Title: One-X; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its heavy, melodic rock fits my interest in albums like One Day Remains and Ten Thousand Fists.
ItemID: NA; Title: 21st Century Breakdown; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in heavier metal and hard rock than punk rock right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Glorious Burden; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The metal sound could suit me, but I would try City of Evil first this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Mezmerize       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its aggressive riffs and unusual rhythms appeal to my interest in Disturbed and Tool.
ItemID: NA; Title: Circus; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I cannot identify the artist from this title, so I would pass.
ItemID: NA; Title: Audioslave; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its strong vocals and heavy rock riffs appeal to me, but I have picked enough albums for this visit.
